description: This source file defines the OpenmrsData interface, which is a core part of the OpenMRS data model. It declares methods related to metadata and data that are person- or patient-specific, and indicates deprecated methods that manage change tracking.

methods.name: getChangedBy
methods.description: Returns the user who made the last change to this data entry, marked as deprecated since version 2.2.

methods.name: setChangedBy
methods.description: Sets the user who made the last change to this data entry, marked as deprecated since version 2.2.

methods.name: getDateChanged
methods.description: Returns the date of the last change to this data entry, marked as deprecated since version 2.2.

methods.name: setDateChanged
methods.description: Sets the date of the last change to this data entry, marked as deprecated since version 2.2.
